analysis.title: ARM Holdings (ARM): First Take: Results above the Street, with positive AGI CPU commentary but royalty miss
key_insights: ARM reported FY2Q27 revenue of $1.44bn vs GS $1.39bn and Street (Visible Alpha) $1.38bn. Operating margin was 44.2% vs GS 42.2% and Street 41.6%.
Operating EPS (excl. SBC) of $0.52 beat GS and the Street at $0.48.
Licensing and other revenue of $773mn was well above GS $677mn and Street $667mn. Royalty revenue of $670mn was well below GS $707mn and Street $708mn.
Management noted increased confidence in achieving up to $2bn in AGI CPU customer demand.
FY3Q27 revenue guidance midpoint of $1.54bn is above the Street at $1.52bn and below GS at $1.57bn. Operating EPS guidance midpoint of $0.56 is above the Street at $0.55 and below GS at $0.60.

GS expects the stock to be range bound after the print. On the call, investors are expected to focus on AGI CPU supply availability, smartphone market recovery visibility and the FY27 royalty revenue outlook.
GS keeps a Sell rating with a 12-month price target of $160, based on 50x normalized EPS of $3.20, against a price of $202.49 (3 Nov 2026 close), implying 21.0% downside.

market_movers.rationale: Price target of $160 is based on 50x normalized EPS of $3.20. Quarter beat on licensing but royalty revenue missed, and GS expects the stock to be range bound.

earnings_insights: ARM FY2Q27 (reported 11/4): revenue $1.44bn (+27.1% YoY, +11.9% QoQ) vs GS $1.385bn (+22.0% YoY) and Street (Visible Alpha consensus) $1.377bn (+21.3% YoY).

FY2Q27 licensing revenue $773mn reported vs GS est $677mn and Street est $667mn (+14.1% and +15.8% above). Royalty revenue $670mn reported vs GS est $707mn and Street est $708mn (-5.3% and -5.4% below).
FY2Q27 operating income (excl. SBC) $638mn vs GS est $584mn and Street est $573mn. Gross margin (excl. SBC) 97.9% vs GS 98.6% and Street 98.2%. Operating margin 44.2% vs GS 42.2% and Street 41.6%.
FY2Q27 EPS (excl. SBC) reported $0.52 vs GS est $0.48 and Street est $0.48.

FY3Q27 guidance: revenue $1.49bn to $1.59bn, midpoint $1.54bn vs GS est $1.569bn and Street est $1.519bn. Operating expense (ex SBC) $825mn vs GS est $811mn and Street est $823mn. EPS (excl. SBC) $0.52 to $0.60, midpoint $0.56 vs GS est $0.60 and Street est $0.55.
risk_factors: Upside risks to the Sell rating: stronger-than-expected Datacenter ramp, better-than-expected operating leverage, better-than-expected execution on chip manufacturing.
Royalty revenue came in 5.3% below GS, with smartphone market recovery visibility and the FY27 royalty outlook still open questions.
